about_short_description.short_description: Next-generation calendar for professionals and teams

product.name: Cron Calendar
product.description: A calendar application designed for professionals and teams to manage events, meetings, and schedules across multiple accounts and time zones.

product.name: Share Availabilities
product.description: A feature that allows users to share available time slots as holds on their calendar, enabling others to book meetings within those windows.

product.name: Notion Integration
product.description: Integration that connects Notion workspaces to Cron, enabling users to attach, view, and create Notion pages and database items directly from calendar events.

product.name: Event Blocking
product.description: A feature that allows users to mark events from one calendar as busy on another calendar to prevent double bookings and manage availability.

product.name: Conferencing Integration
product.description: Integration with conferencing platforms like Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams to auto-add and join meeting links directly from calendar events.
